property_summary: For any caller, if their recorded credit is zero then calling withdrawAll must NOT revert (reference executes no external failing call and succeeds); the mutant executes the call even for zero credit and can revert when the callee is configured to fail, so the mutant can cause withdrawAll to revert for some inputs while the reference never does.
change_summary: Change the conditional to check for oCredit >= 0 (always true for uint) so function body always executes and may attempt to send 0, changing revert behavior for zero balances.
